'''Vicondor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vicondor system/Legends|Vicondor system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Its [[Vicon|inhabitants]] joined with the people of [[Junction V]], [[Delaluna]], and [[Bezim]] to build the [[Station 88 Spaceport]]. This coalition of planets chose to remain loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
